command: cat js/unit-tests/run_with_coverage.json; echo ===; grep -rn "crap4js\|nyc" .github/workflows/*.yml js/unit-tests/*.json 2>/dev/null | head -20; echo ===; env | grep -iE "github|gh_" | sed 's/=.*/=<set>/'

rm -rf /tmp/inst /tmp/cov && /tmp/tools/node_modules/.bin/nyc instrument --cwd . . /tmp/inst > /tmp/nyc_inst.log 2>&1 && rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ /tmp/inst/ && (cd /tmp/inst && git init -q && git add -A -f . >/dev/null 2>&1); echo "exit=$?"
